title: Haalvu
extract:
Haalvu is a  Sentient multi-barreled rifle. It deals pure  Tau damage and its Alternate Fire transforms the barrels into 8 floating burst-fire rifles that auto-target up to 4 nearby enemies.

Characteristics
This weapon deals  Tau damage in both firing modes.
Alternate Fire transforms the weapon between full-auto mode and burst modes.
Burst mode causes the rifle barrels to split apart into miniature rifles that use a 2 shot burst-fire. Miniature Rifles target up to 4 enemies within 40° of the reticle and within 10m of the player. Miniature Rifles remain locked on to enemies while they are within 60° of the reticle and 10m of the player.
Burst mode consumes 1.5 ammo per shot (3 ammo per burst) per target.
Miniature Rifles targets are indicated by a laser pointer when firing.
Switching firing modes takes 3 seconds to complete and can be interrupted. Mode swapping speed is affected by Reload Speed.
Does not use ammo pickups; ammo regenerates over time.
Has a 0.5 second delay after the weapon stops firing before regenerating ammo. Then, regenerates 300 ammo per second; takes 0.5 seconds to regenerate a fully depleted unmodded battery excluding the delay.
If ammo is fully depleted, the weapon will enter a reload animation of 2 seconds. However, it cannot be manually reloaded.
Innate two  polarities.

Acquisition
Haalvu was able to be acquired by watching TennoCon 2026 on WARFRAME's Twitch with a Twitch-linked account for 30 consecutive minutes, between 11:00 a.m. and 4:30 p.m. ET (UTC -4), on July 11th, 2026. It comes with a free Weapon Slot and pre-installed  Orokin Catalyst.

Notes
 Mirage's  Hall of Mirrors clones do not fire the homing projectiles in Alternate Fire mode, instead firing Primary Fire projectiles.

Bugs
Rifles will aim towards the nearest body part of their target, including their weapons, which can cause shots to miss.
The reload animation is skipped on the burst mode if the player has 5 or more stacks of  Primary Crux.

Trivia
Haalvu is the first player weapon that deals  Tau damage.
 Venato Prime can apply  Tau status, but only when applying another Status Effect on enemies.
